name: Runtime - Weekly OS Improvement Radar Review
contract_reason: Weekly main-session reminder to convert repeated friction into OS-improvement candidates without noisy daily review.

payload.text:
Weekly OS-improvement radar review.

Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

Purpose: turn repeated friction into practical OS improvements without creating noise.

Review these proof surfaces first:
- tmp\artifact-staleness-explainer.json
- tmp\lane-collision-preflight.json
- tmp\validator-bundle-router.json
- tmp\worktree-checkpoint-planner.json
- tmp\cron-contract-validator.json
- tmp\cron-control-packet.json
- tmp\pm-control-packet.json
- memory\YYYY-MM-DD.md recent friction notes

If proof is stale, you may refresh review-only local proof with:
python scripts\artifact_staleness_explainer.py --write --validate
python scripts\cron_contract_validator.py --require-contracts --fail-on-drift --write --validate
python scripts\changed_file_validator_router.py --write --validate
python scripts\pm_control_packet.py --write --write-db --validate
python scripts\cron_control_packet.py --write --validate

Look for repeated manual work, false greens, stale artifacts, validator confusion, lane collisions, cron drift, or worktree checkpoint friction. If a high-value candidate exists, report a concise proposal: pain point, recommended tool/procedure, risk reduced, smallest safe next step, and required approval if any.

If nothing material changed, reply exactly NO_REPLY.

Boundary: review-only OS-improvement radar. Do not mutate cron, config, auth, channels, runtime, files, skills, canon, portfolio, cash, sizing, paper/live/account surfaces, or external delivery without separate explicit approval. Do not infer owner approval. Do not create jobs, patches, commits, or apply changes from this reminder alone.
